title: Durable fenced long-running client operation
hard_gates: a new operation creates one user observation, one immutable delivery, generation one, and one server-issued attempt id
an exact prepare replay returns the same turn, delivery, attempt, generation, context, and checkpoint
an ordinary prepare replay never reclaims a live lease
an explicit reclaim rejects a lease that has not expired
an explicit reclaim of an expired lease increments generation and issues a different attempt id
reclaim preserves the original user observation, delivery, context, and latest checkpoint
a heartbeat from the current attempt renews the lease without semantic side effects
a higher checkpoint sequence replaces the latest bounded checkpoint and renews the lease
an exact checkpoint replay is idempotent while sequence drift and regression are rejected
checkpoint payload remains absent from observations, formation schedules, governed memories, lexical projections, vector projections, deliveries, and model context
credential-like or oversized checkpoint content is rejected before persistence
after reclaim the old attempt cannot heartbeat or checkpoint
after reclaim the old attempt cannot record a tool-result observation
after reclaim the old attempt cannot complete, fail, or cancel
the current attempt can resume from the retained checkpoint after Vermory process restart
PostgreSQL restart preserves the operation, attempt, generation, delivery, checkpoint, and terminal state
only completion by the current attempt creates one assistant observation and one formation request
failure creates no assistant observation, formation request, governed memory, or search projection
cancellation creates no assistant observation, formation request, governed memory, or search projection
a late completion after cancellation is rejected rather than replayed
concurrent cancel and complete produce exactly one terminal state and at most one assistant observation
an exact terminal replay by the winning attempt is idempotent and a changed terminal payload is rejected
the same operation id under another tenant cannot observe or mutate this operation
another continuity in the same tenant cannot resume or mutate this operation
a leased operation cannot be completed through the bounded client endpoint
the OpenClaw plugin reconstructs current attempt metadata by repeating prepare after plugin restart
successful allowlisted OpenClaw tool steps use fenced semantic tool results and monotonic progress checkpoints
the existing Hermes bounded prepare complete and fail lifecycle remains compatible
non_claims: the case does not qualify a general workflow scheduler
the case does not treat checkpoints or heartbeats as memory or verified truth
the case does not qualify offline multi-device conflict resolution
the case does not qualify Hermes for long-running recovery
